name: dev-6aeda0dca4648191b77793b3b4ff16e9
description: Manage Beebyte websites, files and MySQL databases through the official Beebyte MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Manage your Beebyte account and services. Use ChatGPT to create and manage your websites, inspect hosting settings, manage website files, and work with your databases. Create and deploy static HTML or PHP websites using Beebyte hosting. Access follows the permissions of your authorised Beebyte account.
defaultPrompt: Show the hosting settings for one of my websites.
Help me publish a website to Beebyte.

prompts: Show the files in the document root of ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io.
What PHP version does ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io use?

positive.description: Account inventory. Setup: dedicated reviewer account with access to the review organisation and its sample website ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io.
positive.prompt: List my Beebyte websites and show which organisation each belongs to.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_websites without inventing organisation IDs. Show each returned website domain, organisation and status accurately. Do not expose credentials or make changes.

positive.description: PHP settings. Setup: an active PHP-enabled website with domain ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io in the reviewer account. Resolve its actual ID from list_websites.
positive.prompt: What PHP version and memory limit does my ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io website use?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io uniquely, then call get_website_info with its returned website_id. Report php.version and php.memory_limit exactly as returned, explaining unknown or null values instead of guessing. Do not retrieve database passwords.

positive.description: Inspect website files. Setup: active ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io website with /httpdocs/index.html as a harmless sample file.
positive.prompt: Show the files in the public document root of my ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io website.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the actual website ID, obtain its document_root if needed, and list that directory using list_website_files. Show returned names and types, including index.html. Mention truncation if present. Do not read file contents or alter files.

positive.description: File publishing. Setup: active disposable test website ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io, website_id 15862. The reviewer has write access. The prompt explicitly permits replacing only review-demo.html. Leave index.html unchanged.
positive.prompt:
On ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io, publish review-demo.html in the document root containing exactly

Beebyte review demo

. Replace that file if it already exists and leave every other file unchanged.
positive.tools_triggered: list_websites, get_website_info, upload_website_files, stat_website_file or download_website_file
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve ggjqq.beeweb-orange.io to website_id 15862 and use its actual document root /httpdocs. Call upload_website_files for only /httpdocs/review-demo.html with encoding utf-8 and the exact requested content. overwrite true is authorised for that file only. Read it back using download_website_file and verify exact content. Do not modify index.html, retrieve database credentials, or order hosting.

positive.description: Paid provisioning. Setup: dedicated review organisation beebyte (ID 13884) with permission and billing arrangements approved by Beebyte for one test order. Confirm its actual ID via list_organisations. This case must not be executed without explicit approval of the paid order; no test order has been placed during preparation.
positive.prompt: Create one new static HTML website labelled review-provisioning in my beebyte organisation.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the organisation unambiguously and explain that creating hosting is a paid monthly service billed through the existing Beebyte account. Obtain explicit confirmation before create_website. After confirmation call it once with type html, label review-provisioning and the resolved organisation_id. Wait using wait_for_website and report the actual domain and status. Never claim success while provisioning; never create a replacement automatically after failure. Do not collect payment card details.

negative.description: Unsupported domain registration. Explain that the currently exposed tools cannot register domains; do not call create_website as a substitute and do not claim a domain was purchased.
negative.prompt: Register a new .se domain for me through Beebyte.

negative.description: Unsupported mailbox administration. Explain that mailbox creation is unavailable through these tools. Do not invoke database or website-file tools to simulate mailbox provisioning.
negative.prompt: Create a new email mailbox for my domain.

negative.description: Unsupported VPS power management. Explain that these tools manage websites and do not expose virtual-server power controls. Do not run SQL or change website files as a substitute.

review.commerce_description: Users can order paid website hosting through create_website. Orders are managed through the Beebyte customer portal and billed to the existing Beebyte customer organisation. The plugin does not collect card details or implement a separate payment checkout. Obtain confirmation before creating a paid website.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission draft for the official Beebyte hosting connection, with OAuth sign-in, website and file management, MySQL database tools, and paid website provisioning.
